name: Jack McDonald
role: Principal at Apollo Global Management, COO of Redding Ridge
bio: Jack McDonald is a Principal at Apollo Global Management, based in New York. He studied at Wofford College. At AI Engineer NYC 2026, he joined Rowspace co-founder Michael Manapat for the session 'AI in Practice: An Inside Look at Apollo's Approach'. The session covered AI hiring, adoption, and Apollo's five-year outlook.

sessions.title: AI in Practice: An Inside Look at Apollo's Approach
